title: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure initiation
text: In order to request PDN disconnection from a PDN, the UE shall send a PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message to the MME, start the timer T3492 and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING (see example in figure 6.5.2.2.1). The PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message shall include the EPS bearer identity of the default bearer associated with the PDN to disconnect from as the linked EPS bearer identity in the PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message
Figure 6.5.2.2.1: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure

notes: The UE sends PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST and starts timer T3492
Network responds with either DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or PDN DISCONNECT REJECT
Either response causes T3492 to stop
